title: Going deeper: The spill is not the child
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Describe events, effort and impact without turning a moment into a permanent judgement.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The mess still needs to be cleaned.
practice: describe what happened and begin the clean-up
principle: Separate responsibility for an event from a judgement about identity.
nextSentence: The mess still needs to be cleaned. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can describe what happened and begin the clean-up.
keyLearning: Separate responsibility for an event from a judgement about identity.
